name: Yogurt
title: Yogurt: free Otter alternative
hook: Otter charges you eight bucks a month to write your meeting notes. This app does it for free.

features.say: It records your mic and call audio, then turns it into notes with next steps.
Then ask it questions across all your meetings, and it links the source. Everything runs on your computer.

caption:
Otter charges $8.33/month (billed yearly) to write your meeting notes. Yogurt does it for free 📝

✅ Records your mic + call audio, no bot joins the call
✅ Writes a summary with next steps
✅ Ask questions across all your meetings
✅ No subscription, no account, runs on your computer

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ First launch downloads the AI models. Mac needs Apple silicon, and you need 8 GB of memory. Tell people on the call you're recording.

Comment "NOTES" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day

#opensource #github #productivity #meetings #ai #freeapps #techtips #privacy
dm_pitch: Yogurt, the free open-source Otter alternative for private meeting notes 📝
